### Introduction to Module

Horse racing at the Kentucky Derby is a high-stakes thoroughbred competition held annually on the first Saturday in May at Churchill Downs in Louisville, Kentucky. Known as “The Most Exciting Two Minutes in Sports,” the Derby features a 1¼-mile (10 furlong) race on a dirt track, where up to 20 three-year-old horses compete for a chance at Triple Crown glory. The race is a fast-paced dash requiring both speed and stamina. Jockeys must navigate position, pace, and track conditions to secure a winning run to the finish line. The Kentucky Derby is the first leg of the Triple Crown, followed by the Preakness Stakes and Belmont Stakes. Horses qualify through a points-based Road to the Kentucky Derby series called prep races. Betting plays a major role in the excitement, with odds reflecting the public’s perception of each horse’s chances to win. Favorites often have low odds, while long shots results in dramatic payouts. Beyond athleticism, the Derby is a cultural spectacle in Southern tradition.

The `horseRacing` dataset features data from the 2025 Kentucky Derby Variables include characteristics such as Finish, Qualifying Points, Jockey, Trainer, Morning Odds, Finish Odds, and more. The relevant variables for this specific module are Finish and Morning Line Odds.   

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Learning Objectives" appearance="minimal"}
Learning Objectives:

1. Students will gain an understanding of the pearson correlation hypothesis test. 

2. Students will practice model building.

:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Methods" appearance="minimal"}
For this activity, students will need to a statistical software such as R. 

Students are expected to understand the concept of hypothesis testing, modeling building, and interpreting output. Students are also expected to now how to code basic plots.

This activity would be suitable for an in-class activity or as an out-of-class assignment taking approximately one class period.
:::



### Data

The `horseRacing.csv` data contains the 2025 Kentucky Derby final results.

Download data: [horseRacing.csv](C:/Users/0211f/GitHub/slu_score_module_development/frhinehart/Horse Racing/CorrelationModule/Data Repository/horseRacing.csv)

<details>

<summary><b>Variable Descriptions</b></summary>

2025 Kentucky Derby results (19 cases with 30 variables) data:

| Variable         | Description                |
|------------------|----------------------------|
| Finish           | Place Horse Finished       |
| Program Number   | Number of Horse            |
| Horse            | Horse's Name               |
| Qualifying Points| Points Earned in Prep Races|
| Trainer          | Trainer's Name             |
| Jockey           | Jockey's Name              |
| Morning Line Odds| Projected Odds Before Race |
| Final Odds       | Actual Odds Post Race      |
| Margin Lengths   | Blank Ends                 |
| Winnings         | Distance Between Finishers | 

</details>
